name: How do I choose the right contractor for storm-damage repairs?
description: Choose a contractor with specific storm-damage experience, proper licensing, insurance, local references, and familiarity with local building codes.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for storm-damage repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a storm-damage restoration contractor, prioritize those with experience in your specific type of damage, such as water extraction or structural repair. Look for a contractor with proper licensing, insurance, and positive local references. It's also beneficial to choose a company that is familiar with local building codes in areas like Alameda or Dublin, as this can streamline the permit approval process and ensure compliance.
